topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing and overview of the lecture's themes on inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and damage recognition by innate receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms and receptor families through which the innate immune system senses microbial products and cellular damage.

topics.label: Inflammatory response propagation and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the physiological and pathological processes triggered by immune activation, including sentinel signaling, leukocyte recruitment, lymphatic drainage, and septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the immune response is terminated and how tissues are repaired, as well as the adaptations and pathologies associated with unresolved chronic inflammation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing and an announcement for the next lecture.
